title: Smart Character Creator Pro Input Schema
description: Complete input schema with maximum selectable choices, Auto options, multilingual settings, and drag-and-drop image reference uploads. Final generated prompt output remains normal descriptive plain text, not JSON.

workflow_mode.description: Skill operating mode for this standalone app. Only modes that can run from the submitted form are supported.

ui_language.description: Language used by the UI. Must default to English.

output_language.description: Language used for final plain-text prompts.

shot_types.description: Single shot/framing type for each generated prompt. Choose one; do not combine multiple framings in one image.

reference_images.description: Optional image files uploaded through the UI by drag-and-drop or add-file button. Do not require or ask the user to type image URLs. Images may show a person, face, clothing, pose, background, environment, lighting, mood, or style reference.

file.description: Uploaded image file content supplied by UI file upload or drag-and-drop.

usage_instruction.description: Optional natural-language instruction for how to use this image reference.
